Chapter 6633: On The Verge Of Death

Chapter 6633: On The Verge Of Death

Staff Ancestor turned around to gaze at the newcomer.

“Crackle!” Countless tribulation bolts accompanied him, leaving a winding trail behind. Thunderous explosions echoed outward.

“Calamities.” Everyone knew who it was - another overlord in Three Immortals. He reached this realm long before Staff Ancestor.

Everyone else, despite being at a safe distance, retreated farther.

“A battle between overlords.” An emperor turned pale and maximized his distance.

Space was going to be devastated. Any remnant blast to Three Immortals could destroy a corner of their world.

Of course, the other reason to run was due to Calamities’ tribulation potential. Some considered him to be more frightening than the supreme Lord of Life and Death, the terrifying Devil Ancestor, or the dark Primal Yin Immortal Ghost. “Calamities.” Staff Ancestor had a serious expression.

“I want this thing.” Calamities declared, gazing at the spring of creation as if it were his already. Tribulations detonated behind him, scaring the hell out of listeners.

“I’m afraid you’re late.” Staff Ancestor said.

Both were overlords but Staff was considerably younger, many times the junior of Calamities. However, she had no intention of giving up.

His intense gaze could cleave the world and an overlord in two. Nevertheless, she met his gaze and seemed ready to engage.

A single breath from them could destroy a corner of Heaven World. Therefore, everyone trembled uncontrollably. Some prayed for just a conversation, not an actual fight. Of course, overlords never listened to prayers.

“You wish to stop me?” Calamities’ lightning bolts appeared ready to strike her.

As she stood, her celestial light flowed through the staff, forming a mighty defense. Anything illuminated by her light also enjoyed heightened durability.

Overlords truly had incredible potential, capable of protecting worlds.

“She’s protecting us.” Others could feel this effect.

“We’re safe.” Emperors and desolate gods felt safe.

“This doesn’t mean anything, overlords can devour worlds.” A primal ancestor nearby dragged them back to reality.

Sure, her light could protect them but she could also devour everything at any moment, the same with Calamities.

“Dao Brother, show me the power of your heavenly tribulations.” She said with a solemn demeanor, no longer as carefree as she had been before.

The scene became tense due to her uncompromising stance.

Calamities assessed her again with his exceptional vision. He noticed something and said: “No wonder, you’re dying.”

Her expression changed only for a split second upon hearing this.

“How can this be?” A heaven-slayer blurted.

Grand Preceptor and his peers took another look, unable to verify this. Visceraless, who had just clashed with her, didn’t notice anything either.

Her vitality and dao power appeared infinite. How could she be near death? Moreover, she was the youngest overlord. If anything, Calamities should be the one at death’s door.
